name: scenario_4_simultaneous_fold
description: Two perturbations land in the SAME decision window: Sarah (primary) goes offline mid-flight AND Priya (higher-qualified, snapshot-offline) comes online. The batch fold evaluates both at once and makes ONE hop straight to Priya (R2B) — skipping the intermediate backup (David, q 5.80) that sequential single-event handling would have stranded on. One window, one decision, no double-hop.
